meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Predict regulatory features and gene expression from DNA sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict functional features from DNA sequences

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可根据基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA 序列,调用远程 DNA 模型预测启动子、剪接位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、基因表达(log TPM)和从头基因注释,返回结构化结果。无需本地 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当用户给出基因符号、基因组区域或 DNA 序列并想预测调控/表达等,或提到 Genomic Intelligence、genomicintelligence.ai 等字样时触发。

say.text: 帮我预测 TP53 基因的启动子区域
对这段 DNA 序列预测剪接供体和受体位点
预测 HBB 基因在 K562 细胞中的表达量

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can use hosted DNA models to predict promoters, splice sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation from a gene symbol, region, or DNA/FASTA sequence, returning structured results. No local GPU or model weights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a gene symbol, genomic region, or DNA/FASTA sequence and wants a related prediction, or mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, etc.

say_en.text: Predict the promoter region of TP53.
say_en.note: Claude calls the promoter task and returns promoter-region scores.

say_en.text: Predict splice donor and acceptor sites for this DNA sequence.
say_en.note: Claude calls the splice task and marks donor/acceptor sites.

say_en.text: Predict HBB expression in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Claude uses the TSS-centred 9,198 bp window and calls the expression task.
